verdict.rationale: Simular's docs say Sai works across the entire operating system (desktop apps, browsers, file systems, terminals) like a human. Its open-source framework controls computers via UI, keyboard and mouse across environments. It runs on cloud Windows machines or on the user's own macOS/Windows device. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-app OS control, explicit documentation of keyboard-shortcut handling.
